newsitem.title: ROMANIA: January-June construction 8.0 pct up in Romania.
newsitem.headline: January-June construction 8.0 pct up in Romania.

text.p: Romania's construction output rose by 8.0 percent in the first half of 1996 from the year ago period, a National Statistics Board (CNS) report said.
It said private companies took 69 percent of the work, up sharply from 52.5 percent in the same period last year.

Official forecast says construction should expand by 9.4 percent this year, when it will account for 6.6 percent of Romania's gross domestic product. Last year construction rose by 12.6 percent from 1994. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
